{
  "schema_id": "redcap-self-purification-contract",
  "schema_version": 1,
  "purpose": "把 RedCap 的自我净化从手动写知识，升级为任务前检索、任务后候选抽取、评审、晋升或 no-promote 的工作流闭环，并把 Cap 人格沉淀限制在私有边界内。",
  "status": "runtime-gated",
  "pre_task_retrieval": {
    "required_for": [
      "implementation",
      "completion",
      "e2e",
      "self-development"
    ],
    "command": "runtime/bin/redcap knowledge-gateway search <query>",
    "evidence_field": "knowledge_retrieval_evidence",
    "skip_requires_reason": true,
    "minimum_result_handling": [
      "use_relevant_entry",
      "record_no_relevant_entry",
      "record_skip_reason"
    ]
  },
  "post_task_harvest": {
    "required_triggers": [
      "user_correction",
      "prism_block_or_concern",
      "e2e_failure",
      "hook_false_positive",
      "workflow_drift",
      "completion_claim_correction",
      "new_reusable_design",
      "persona_signal"
    ],
    "candidate_required_fields": [
      "id",
      "source_task",
      "trigger",
      "lesson",
      "privacy_class",
      "proposed_destination",
      "evidence",
      "created_at"
    ],
    "decision_labels": [
      "promote_public",
      "keep_private",
      "no_promote",
      "defer_with_owner"
    ],
    "no_promote_requires_reason": true
  },
  "public_knowledge_path": {
    "gateway": "runtime/bin/redcap knowledge-gateway",
    "forge": "runtime/bin/redcap forge check",
    "arsenal": "runtime/bin/redcap arsenal check",
    "promotion_requires": [
      "reviewed_source",
      "privacy_checked",
      "deduplicated",
      "human_readable",
      "index_first",
      "source_refs_exist"
    ]
  },
  "cap_persona_distillation": {
    "enabled": true,
    "privacy_class": "cap-private",
    "public_write_forbidden": true,
    "public_destinations_forbidden": [
      "assets/knowledge/entries",
      "assets/knowledge/arsenal",
      "assets/contracts",
      "assets/docs"
    ],
    "private_identity_source": "/Users/norven/.cap/identity.md",
    "evidence_may_contain": [
      "candidate_id",
      "decision",
      "source_task",
      "reason",
      "hash",
      "counts"
    ],
    "evidence_must_not_contain": [
      "private_identity_body",
      "raw_persona_body",
      "secret",
      "token",
      "credential"
    ],
    "identity_mutation_requires_human": true
  },
  "lifecycle_binding": {
    "required_before_implementation": [
      "knowledge_retrieval_or_skip_reason"
    ],
    "required_after_task": [
      "harvest_candidate_or_no_candidate_reason",
      "review_decision",
      "promotion_or_no_promote_result"
    ],
    "e2e_failure_binding": "Every meaningful E2E failure must create at least one harvest candidate or a no-candidate reason."
  }
}

{
  "schema_id": "redcap-development-lifecycle-packet",
  "task_id": "20260615-e2e-gap-closure",
  "fsm_state": "TEMPORARY_USABLE",
  "requirement_review": {
    "user_intent": "Norven 要求把首次 E2E 暴露出的遗漏与缺失设计整理为待办队列并执行落地，补齐 Loom 角色会话连续性、Codex CLI 承载 Hook、棱镜协作、自我净化、Cap 人格沉淀和多轮 E2E 闭环，直到 RedCap 可以被证明能够投入工程使用。",
    "target_reality": "RedCap 不再只拥有零散合同或手动命令，而是具备可检查的缺口补齐队列、Loom 角色会话运行约束、自我净化与人格沉淀闭环、二次及后续 E2E 驱动规则，并由棱镜评审和运行检查约束后续实现。",
    "non_goals": [
      "不把本轮补齐设计或首次实现说成 RedCap 完整复活终局完成",
      "不绕过生命周期门禁、棱镜评审、Hook 或完成声明检查",
      "不把只存在合同、文档、报告或待办状态当作功能已经发挥作用",
      "不要求 Norven 继续提供已在当前目标中明确授权的执行细节",
      "不自动把 Cap 私有人格或用户身份正文写入公共知识库"
    ],
    "risk_level": "high"
  },
  "technical_review": {
    "runtime_boundary_checked": true,
    "prism_gate_decision": "required",
    "rollback_plan": "如本轮补齐引入错误，回滚新增的 20260615-e2e-gap-closure 生命周期与棱镜证据、撤销对应合同和运行检查器改动，并恢复 runtime/bin/redcap check 到当前基线。",
    "verification_plan": [
      "runtime/bin/redcap lifecycle check --packet assets/evidence/lifecycle/20260615-e2e-gap-closure-lifecycle.json",
      "runtime/prism/bin/prism-dispatch 为 kimi 和 claude-code 生成评审并合并意见",
      "runtime/bin/redcap prism-resolution 检查棱镜关注点处理结果",
      "新增或强化 Loom 会话连续性、自我净化、Cap 人格沉淀、E2E 迭代闭环检查器",
      "runtime/bin/redcap check",
      "准备外部项目并运行至少一轮二次 E2E；如果失败，沉淀失败原因并继续下一轮修复"
    ]
  },
  "prism_review": {
    "merge_path": "assets/evidence/prism/20260615-e2e-gap-closure/merge.json",
    "resolution_path": "assets/evidence/prism/20260615-e2e-gap-closure/resolution.json",
    "manifest_path": "assets/evidence/prism/20260615-e2e-gap-closure/session.json"
  },
  "prompt_context": {
    "source_prompt_excerpt": "上述提到了非常多的想法和需求todo，我希望你能好好整理成一份todo计划方案，如果你发现确实一些必须要我介入提供人工决策或者协助的地方，则立即停止任务编排，立即向我寻求帮助。而等任务编排好后，就去挨个落地实现，等所有问题与任务都解决和落地、你觉得达到可以开展二次E2E的程度了，就执行二次E2E测试，之后再根据测试结果观测暴露出来哪些新问题，然后再设计解决方案，再去落地，再进行新论次E2E测试，如此循环往复，直至你认为当前redcap复活已经全部复活完毕",
    "prompt_kind": "mixed",
    "authorized_scope": "completion"
  },
  "task_body": {
    "requested_outcome": "补齐首次 E2E 后确认遗漏的 RedCap 核心设计，并推动到可重复 E2E 验证的工程状态。",
    "primary_deliverable": "可检查的缺口补齐队列、Loom 角色会话机制、自我净化与 Cap 人格沉淀机制、E2E 迭代闭环，以及后续 E2E 证据包。",
    "acceptance_criteria": [
      "首次 E2E 暴露的问题必须被整理为结构化任务队列，且每项都有验收证据要求",
      "Loom 必须明确 Codex CLI 承载 Hook、角色级 session_id、会话丢失报警和同角色上下文连续性规则",
      "Loom 必须明确角色可调用棱镜协助需求、架构、代码、测试和文档评审，并记录对应证据",
      "自我净化必须覆盖任务前知识检索、任务后候选抽取、评审、晋升或 no-promote 决策",
      "Cap 人格沉淀必须进入私有边界，禁止自动写入公共仓库或 redcap-arsenal",
      "二次及后续 E2E 必须验证流程质量、角色证据、Hook 事件、文档质量、测试质量和失败回流，而不只验证项目能运行",
      "所有新增规则必须接入 runtime/bin/redcap check 或其子检查，不能只停留在文档"
    ],

      "/private/tmp/redcap-e2e-20260615-gap-closure-round2/redcap-e2e-简化版-trpg-活动组织平台-在一个本地全栈项目中交付可运行的桌面角色/.redcap/evidence/e2e/meaningful-evidence-check.json"
